title: Deputy Valuev talked about communicating with phone scammers
text:
State Deputy Deputy Deputy Duma Nikolai Valuev talked about how he communicates with the scammers by phone. About this report “argument and truth.”
According to the deputy, he enjoyed the calls from the scammers. As Valuev was designated, he recently received a lot of calls from attackers – they asked him to perform work with meters replacement. At the same time, Deputy Police added that in such calls, he brought the fraudsters of Muslims that they were hung up.
These calls, assuming, give me a lot of fun. The highest rhythmic exercise is when they can stand and throw the phone, or start to swear quietly and thus, still hanging the phone. I had time, I was enthusiastic with myself. Perhaps this is the way the grandmother saved from this scam, because during this time he did not pass her, he said.
However, Valuev still emphasizes that it is better to have no joy with the crooks in this way.
“It is better to drop the phone. However, scammers are not without psychological techniques, so this is necessary to have life experience. If you are not ready, it is better not to play such games, Value has added value.
Earlier, a press secretary of Russian President Dmitry Peskov said that the scammers over the phone called him.
